about: Real archive directory listings parsed by tests/test_routeviews_corpus.py, and two updates files read by tests/test_mrt_corpus.py. Fetched by tools/fetch_corpus.py into a cache outside the repository; never vendored. Each pin is the page as served on the read date; a completed month is chosen so the listing should not grow, and a re-render by the operator shows up as a MISMATCH, never as a silent new pin.
